sources.title: XLS-R: Self-supervised Cross-lingual Speech Representation Learning at ...
sources.snippet: This paper presents XLS-R, a large-scale model for cross-lingual speech representation learning based on wav2vec 2.0. We train models with up to 2B parameters on nearly half a million hours of publicly available speech audio in 128 languages, an order of magnitude more public data than the largest known prior work.
